audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Kayle or Skill for levels 1 through 4 while every one of whys[0..3] describes Zac winning them outright ('concede CS, do not trade', 'pre-6 all-in', 'can chunk you toward a kill', 'you lose every extended trade'). It also gave Kayle the first-item row that whys[5] calls a coinflip.
audit.why: 47.94% over 315 games is a losing lane for Kayle early; Zac is a CC-engage tank against her worst frame, and she only reclaims it at 6 and again at two items.
audit.corrected: Zac, Zac, Zac, Zac, Kayle, Skill, Kayle — matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Zac levels 1-3, Kayle 6, contested first item, Kayle 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never names any Zac ability except Elastic Slingshot, and gives no cooldown for that either. Elastic Slingshot's grounding was never mentioned.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s — a 21s rank-1 window is the single biggest punish opportunity in the lane — and it GROUNDS, which matters because Kayle's own escape is movement speed, not a dash. Unstable Matter is a 5s, 350-range hit for a percentage of your MAX health, so building HP or armour is the wrong answer and MR is right. Stretching Strikes is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s at 800 range and resets his auto, so the wind-up is the tell. Cell Division heals him off dropped blobs and revives him from bloblets on death.
audit.corrected: Real names, the 21s and 5s and 14s cooldowns, the grounding, the percent-max-HP damage and the revive are now on the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] was titled 'Let him eat blobs' with unrelated boilerplate underneath, and the MR-vs-HP logic was never explained.
audit.why: Cell Division refunds health off blobs and revives him; Unstable Matter is percent max health magic damage, which is why the tldr's 'build MR' is right and stacking HP would be wrong.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Zac contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Stretching Strikes reaches 800 and his blobs heal back every point of Q poke — concede CS rather than trade at level 1.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Zac's Elastic Slingshot is down.
edits.after: He slings in and chains Q into W for a pre-6 all-in while you have one rank of W and no escape.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Zac must walk into your range.
edits.after: Cell Division heals what your Q chips, and a level-3 sling can chunk you toward a kill before R exists.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Elastic Slingshot's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You lose every extended trade pre-6: his CC locks you and the blobs refund health. Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — punish it.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Zac's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R blanks the whole sling engage — pop it as he lands and kite the Q recast. This is the first stage you own.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Elastic Slingshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's and E's missing-health damage out-DPS his sustain, but his tank HP keeps engages a coinflip.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Zac carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: E's percent-HP on-hit under R melts a finite tank — Zac has no burst to punish your invulnerability window.

edits.before: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zac Elastic Slingshot: matchup-defining — 21s at rank 1, and it grounds. Dodge it, then punish for 21s. - Unstable Matter: 5s, percent max HP. - Stretching Strikes: 14s, 800 range, resets his auto.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 21s at rank 1 and it grounds — dodge it, then the lane is yours.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Unstable Matter is 5s and burns percent max HP — build MR, not HP.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Cell Division refunds his health and revives him — cut it early.

edits.before: Track Zac's Elastic Slingshot: His engage. Dodge it. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot: 21s at rank 1, grounds you. Unstable Matter is 5s, percent max HP.
